title: Creatorz
tagline: Creatorz is a decentralized video sharing platform where content creators can monetize their videos with social tokens and NFTs. Users can buy, sell, and collect videos as NFTs and earn advertising rewards. Creatorz is a video platform that empowers creators and users with web3
description:
Nowadays, many people are building their careers in content creation. Creatorz helps
them to raise funds directly from their audience, and then the audience gets premium content for free as the ad rewards are instantly credited to the creators. In Creatorz, the user's data is safely secured on the blockchain network, and videos have no censorship problems. Anyone can share their thoughts without any second
thoughts. If the users don't like the content, they can report to the app, and the video
can't be displayed if the views-to-note ratio favors the video removal.
Users can earn passive income by buying the video NFTs and also trading the social
tokens they had purchased at the launch time at their price.

We have a marketplace where users can list their videos, rooms, and social token to get cash if needed. 

We have made this ppt explaining the scope of our project https://www.canva.com/design/DAFeO20E6Q0/3CYfmabNvCZH8bgh3YbeGg/view?utm_content=DAFeO20E6Q0&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton

In the marketplace, first, users must get a social token to buy a video, room, or pass.

We have thought of many more features to make it as scalable to large audiences, but we are not able to implement all of the features right now
how_its_made:
I started building this Project earlier this November, upto now I built some parts of the
Front-End and started programming smart contract. I’m using the ERC1155 standard for
NFTs and social tokens. For front-end, I’m using Next for file storage and hosting
IPFS makes the entire application decentralized.
https://github.com/KarthikeyaGundumogula/Creatorz
This Project brings more people to choose content creation as their mainstream, and
it will help them to raise funds directly from their audience. Since creators can earn
enough money from ads, they can provide premium content for free. This project
will be the best content-sharing platform, Bringing more and more people to
the Ethereum ecosystem.

We have used push protocol to integrate notifications in our dApp.So that user can get information when a new video is uploaded, or someone makes a room or lists something in the marketplace. We are also providing them with opt-in or opt-out button inside our dApp
